cv.title: Resume
cv.bio: Software developer with 5 years of experience, currently in a technical leadership role coordinating a team of 4 to 6 developers. Experienced in delivering web and mobile applications, defining architecture, code review and adopting engineering best practices, including automated testing and CI/CD. Focused on quality, system integration through REST APIs and translating business requirements into technical solutions.

hero.title: Software Developer
hero.description: Passionate about technology, specialized in Frontend Development.
data: I am a Software Developer and Frontend Lead with experience building web, mobile, and desktop applications.

I have a particular interest in software architecture, code quality, performance, and technical leadership. I enjoy working across different layers of development, tackling technical challenges, and collaborating with teams to build scalable solutions.
I am also the founder of Modullum, where I explore the product side of technology, turning ideas into digital solutions that solve real problems.
I believe in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and the importance of choosing the right tools and approaches for each problem.

work.title: Frontend Lead
work.description: I lead a team of 4 to 6 developers delivering scalable web and mobile applications. I work on frontend architecture definition, technical decision-making, and the implementation of engineering practices that ensure quality and performance.
list: Leading a team of 4 to 6 developers, managing deliveries, priorities, and capacity
Defining web and mobile application architecture and technical decisions aligned with business requirements
Promoting engineering best practices: code review, automated testing, and CI/CD
Translating business requirements into technical specifications, supporting implementation, quality, and maintenance
Building scalable applications with React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, and REST API integration
Focus on performance, observability, and high-quality solution delivery

work.title: Frontend Developer
work.description: As a Frontend Developer at ETIC, I built interfaces and intuitive digital experiences with React.js and Next.js, focusing on UI/UX, performance, and team collaboration.
list: Building interfaces with React.js and Next.js while keeping up with frontend technology developments
Implementing elegant and intuitive UI/UX design
Optimizing performance for fast application loading
Collaborating and communicating effectively throughout development
Continuously learning and adapting to new technologies and contexts

work.title: Fullstack Developer
work.description: As a Fullstack Developer at Novagrolider, I worked across different layers of development, from web and mobile interfaces to APIs, services, and desktop applications.
list: Frontend: developed dynamic interfaces with React.js, mobile applications with React Native, and responsive styling with Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and CSS; built desktop applications using C# WinForm.
Backend: developed fast and efficient APIs with Node.js (Express and Fastify), built scalable web services with C# and .NET Core, and implemented communication between services using WCF.
Versioning and collaboration: used Git for version control and collaboration.
Packaging and distribution: distributed applications with Docker.

projects.title: Projects that define my professional journey
projects.description: Throughout my career as a developer, I have worked on many projects. Many are open source, so feel free to explore the code and contribute your own improvements.

articles.title: Articles that provide tips and knowledge
articles.description: Throughout my career as a developer, I have written several articles to help new developers stand out in the software industry.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Don't hesitate to reach out. I'm available for work opportunities, collaborations, or just to chat about technology and software development.
